title: Release on regular cadence
body:
I see a lot of activity on the repo, which is great.

It'd be awesome if packaged point releases could be made more frequently. We've been on 0.2 for a while now.
author: gradients-rogo

comments.body: Hi @gradients-rogo, the package is currently in a preview stage, so releases are less frequent. Once it goes to GA(next week), we plan to have a weekly release cadence.

title: Typo in project description page
body:
The current project description has:


Google Gen AI Java SDK provides an interface for developers to integrate Google's generative models into their **Python** applications. This is an early stage release. API is subject to change. Please do not use this SDK in production environments at this stage.


Instead of `Python` it should say:  " ... generative models into their **Java** applications "
author: markpollack
